subject: libstan is dead, long live libstan!

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: libstan is dead, long live libstan!
parts:
I just submitted a PR which removes libstan.a and makes Stan fully header only for models.  This is done using C++ template magic so there's no need for models to include a special file exactly once.  The only thing is that the interfaces will need to be updated.  I have a PR in progress for CmdStan, but PyStan and RStan will need to be updated as well once it's merged so I wanted to give everyone a heads up.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] libstan is dead, long live libstan!
parts:
I think Allen took a different approach where there is a special header that has to be included exactly once per executable unit.  In essence, the source for libstan.a was getting included and compiled by the interfaces.  The approach taken in the PR is the one described here http://stackoverflow.com/a/11709860/4294303 which truly makes it a header-only library and is a bit cleaner.  It relies on C++'s ability to ensure that a template is only instantiated once, regardless of how many translation units it is included in.

Cheers,
Marcus
